archetypes.name: review-cli-parity
archetypes.rationale: The new Python review verbs must preserve old review pipeline KV and artifact contracts.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the Python review CLI entrypoints against the retired shell behavior. Focus on argument forwarding, environment inheritance, quiet-mode routing, and status/KV parity. Pay particular attention to review-core stage ordering and delegated subprocess boundaries Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: retired-reference-sweep
archetypes.rationale: This change deletes many shipped bash entrypoints and retargets broad docs and test routing.
archetypes.prompt_body: Audit for stale references to the retired C1b scripts and harnesses. Check docs, skills, topology, lint config, relevant-checks routing, and security prose. Verify retained bash dependencies are still named only where they remain live Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: review-and-fix-handoff
archetypes.rationale: Nested implement review depends on command-array defaults and IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR inheritance.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the review-and-fix cutover to Python review commands. Verify default argv arrays, executable-path overrides, IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR handoff, MAV tally handoff, and compose-findings log flushing remain compatible with Step 5 Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
